title: Ephemeral warmlet prewarming and tenant-fairshare deprioritization window
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleets occasionally face head-of-line coldstarts when multiple tenants burst concurrently. Large tenants can monopolize ephemeral warm pools and push small/interactive tenants into high-latency cold starts. This PR introduces two coordinated features: 1) Ephemeral warmlets: very short-lived, lightweight prewarmed worker slots that are proactively created when a tenant's recent short-tail qps increases beyond a threshold; warmlets are tracked per-tenant and recycled aggressively to avoid long-term capacity drift. 2) Tenant fairshare deprioritization window: a short, configurable window (default 45s) applied after a tenant consumes its short-term warmlet allotment; during the window the tenant remains available but is deprioritized for ephemeral prewarming to protect interactive SLA of other tenants. Both features are safety-gated behind the new runtime flag --enable-ephemeral-warmlets and default to disabled for existing Dedicated clusters. Key changes: autoscaler: new warmlet allocator and scoring policy, integration tests for scoring fairness; runtime: warmlet lifecycle manager, metrics and eviction policy; scheduler: updated placement hints to prefer warmlets for interactive routes; telemetry: new metrics warmlet_reuse_rate, tenant_deprioritize_count, warmlet_eviction_latency, plus a combined utilreporter gauge warmlet_headroom_ratio. Rollout plan: opt-in config for dedicated pools, gradual ramp via canary config targeting 5% → 25% → 100% of fleets, monitor warmlet_reuse_rate and 99th pct tail-latency for interactive tenants, automatic rollback if warmlet_reuse_rate < 12% after 30 minutes. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-8701) [x] unit and integration tests [x] canary config and console flags [x] metrics + dashboards [x] documentation update in /docs/ops/dedicated-warmlets.md [x] migration plan and safety gate docs.

review_thread:
Reviewer: Diego Alvarez — The allocator logic looks reasonable but I'm worried about churn on small clusters. Please add an integration test that simulates 200 tenants with bursty traffic and assert no more than 15% additional pod churn.
Author (Maya): Added integration test warmlet_end_to_end_test.go that replays traffic patterns; results included in CI run.
Reviewer: Sasha Patel — Can we make the deprioritization window tenant-configurable per-account? Some customers want tighter behavior. Also ensure this doesn't bypass per-tenant committed capacity.
Author: Window is configurable via dedicated_config->ephemeral_warmlet_window_secs and we explicitly honor tenant reservation before any warmlet allocation; added a unit test for reservation precedence.
Reviewer: Amir Hussein — Lint flagged a couple of race conditions in the allocator; uncommented locking around lastUse tracking and added comment about lock ordering. Also validate metrics tags for tenant_id.
Author: Addressed and added race-test harness; updated telemetry tags to include safe truncated tenant hash.
Approvals: Diego approved (LGTM), Sasha approved with comment addressed, Amir gave final approval after race fixes.
Merge: merged by squash after CI green and canary configs added.
release_notes: Introduces ephemeral warmlets (opt-in) to reduce short-tail coldstart latency and a tenant deprioritization window to protect interactive SLAs. Feature is behind a runtime flag and disabled by default for existing Dedicated clusters. Metrics added: warmlet_reuse_rate, tenant_deprioritize_count, warmlet_eviction_latency. See docs/ops/dedicated-warmlets.md for configuration and rollout guidance.
